notes: All envelopes satisfy the application schema; all JSON bodies parse without rewriting.
The upstream co2 monthly file has a six-field header and seven-field data rows. Its original bytes are retained. The other three CSV samples have consistent field counts.
The four commit-diff samples are actual pinned GitHub diffs; the Rust complete-line prefix ends before the full upstream diff ends. No claim is made that a truncated diff is applicable.
Samples within one repository are correlated. Carbon dioxide and global-temperature CSVs are both numerical time series; this set does not cover all CSV distributions.
Missing preset TypeScript source paths are recorded exclusions, not replaced sources. No sample was chosen or removed using compression output.

The Japanese repository README is English despite its predeclared repository-language label; actual non-English coverage is five inputs: three Chinese and two Japanese. This provenance correction does not alter the frozen source or corpus bytes.
